task: CH-05B Jev independent ledger and recovery
comparison: Working tree plus untracked source modules; HEAD equalled baseline at review start
standards: code-review Standards and its 12 Fowler heuristics

checks.conclusion: Business DTOs remain centralized immutable snapshots; Decimal USD and UTC, with no I/O or permission decisions.
Original full message/run scope and independent policy/session/config identity are verified; conservative quota accounting in caller-owned short transactions.
Single CAS claim, immutable accounting and conditional decision adoption; recovery/cancel never select provider/model or finish the main run.

HTTP stays outside transactions. Success and cancellation results share strict DTO/request/scope/hash validation; received cancellation accounting settles without answer adoption, then cancellation propagates.
Independent actor/session/workspace/request hash permissions, fixed recipient, policy-id digest ledger, configuration and authorization generations, app-loop execution ownership.
Only three additive tables reference existing assistant_runs; immutable input, claim and receipts; no second queue.
Historical input/config/policy/source/identity/receipt/decision and budget evidence cross-checked independently of current live authorization.
Main schema is captured from baseline, historical versions retained; narrow bootstrap/migration/backup/startup integration.

Single-call trusted preflight checked before secret and before POST; default deny, no new SDK, raw-data logs or environment-controlled destination. Cancellation carries a domain JudgeResult only after receipt, with non-ok status and empty answers; no new credential or authorization path.

probe_cases: Independent write transaction finishes while actual loopback HTTP waits; one POST, repeat execution does not resend; main run and event count unchanged
No runtime/config/policy and Main runtime cannot reserve Jev; no secret lookup or ledger mutation
Frozen Main DDL exactly equals baseline git source; native and non-native schemas add only Jev ledger objects
independent_verification.scope_note: First freeze: all three cases passed; preserved unchanged. Only two product files subsequently changed; their diff and one directly relevant cancellation contract were independently rechecked.

limitations: Only local review artifacts were written; no product, author tests, project state or commit changes.
No real credentials/materials or external network/model calls.
Author target regressions and Windows validation were not rerun or counted as independent results.
Native Jev UI, main-runner integration, actual vendor pricing and additional material mapping are explicit later scope, not defects of this slice.
Standards review does not replace the independent Spec axis or production approval.

supplemental_verification.probe: Real loopback response decoded, external cancellation during AsyncClient cleanup; safe receipt persists and cancellation still propagates.

closed_spec_followup.origin: Independent Spec axis after first Standards report
closed_spec_followup.issue: Post-decode cleanup cancellation previously lost safe received usage and provider request ID.
closed_spec_followup.resolution: JevCancelledError transports only a non-ok safe JudgeResult; execution validates identity through the shared result boundary, settles without a decision, then re-raises CancelledError.
